story: As a developer, I want a monorepo with Java, Python and web modules building in CI, so that every change is tested
acceptance_criteria: CI runs unit tests, scans and RTM check on every pull request; main is protected

story: As a developer, I want Docker Compose for local development with a CPU model stub, so that I can work without a GPU
acceptance_criteria: `docker compose up` starts web, API, Postgres, Valkey, MinIO and stub worker; README documents it

story: As an operator, I want staging and production environments defined in OpenTofu, so that environments are reproducible
acceptance_criteria: Plan and apply succeed from CI; secrets from vault

story: As an operator, I want OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs with dashboards, so that I can see SLOs
acceptance_criteria: Dashboards for latency, errors, queue depth, GPU use, cost per song

story: As the team, I want ACE-Step 1.5 benchmarked on a rented GPU, so that we know real time and cost per take
acceptance_criteria: Report with seconds per take, VRAM, cost per take for 3 GPU types; licence file archived

story: As the team, I want a Hindi and Hinglish quality spike, so that we know if the beachhead language works
acceptance_criteria: 20 prompts per language generated and scored by 3 native speakers; go or fallback decision

epic_name: Validation and growth (waitlist, interviews, listening tests)
story: As the founder, I want a waitlist page with local prices shown, so that we measure interest and price response
acceptance_criteria: Page live in English and Hindi; sign-ups stored with consent; price variant recorded

epic_name: Validation and growth (waitlist, interviews, listening tests)
story: As the founder, I want 20 creator interviews done with a script, so that demand hypotheses are tested
acceptance_criteria: Interview notes in repository; synthesis against H-001 to H-005

story: As a creator, I want to sign in with Google or an email code, so that I can start quickly
acceptance_criteria: Sign-in works; sessions secure per REQ-SEC-01; 18+ check at sign-up

story: As a user, I want to choose English or Hindi, so that the app speaks my language
acceptance_criteria: Locale switch persists; all MVP strings in both languages

story: As a user, I want to export or delete my data, so that I control my information
acceptance_criteria: Export JSON plus files; deletion per DPIA section 6

story: As a creator, I want to describe a vibe and get two takes, so that I get music for my video
acceptance_criteria: API-001 and API-002 with SSE; two takes delivered; p95 under 60 s in staging

story: As the system, I want a durable Postgres job queue with retries and dead-letter, so that jobs survive restarts
acceptance_criteria: Jobs claimed with SKIP LOCKED; retry with backoff; dead-letter visible in admin

story: As a creator, I want to see my queue position and wait time, so that I know when my song is ready
acceptance_criteria: Live region announces status; estimate within ±30%

story: As a producer, I want Beat mode with genre, BPM, key and instruments, so that I can make instrumentals
acceptance_criteria: Validation per REQ-F-04; tempo check runs on output

story: As the system, I want a Lyria fallback with a daily spend cap, so that paid users still get songs when GPUs are busy
acceptance_criteria: Fallback used only when routed; cap enforced; cost logged

story: As an artist, I want to paste lyrics in Hindi, Hinglish or English, so that my words become a song
acceptance_criteria: Grapheme counting; NFC; language tag stored; custom mode works

story: As a creator, I want the AI to write lyrics from a topic and mood, so that I can make a song without writing
acceptance_criteria: Sectioned lyrics in chosen language; moderation applied

story: As the system, I want every event written to a hash-chained ledger, so that provenance is provable
acceptance_criteria: Chain verification test passes; tamper test fails as expected

story: As a user, I want my downloads labelled and watermarked with content credentials, so that they meet AI rules
acceptance_criteria: AI label metadata, valid C2PA manifest, detectable watermark on every export

story: As anyone, I want to verify a file or certificate, so that I can check its origin
acceptance_criteria: Verify page with rate limits and coarse anonymous answers

story: As a creator, I want a library of my songs and takes, so that I can find my work
acceptance_criteria: List, search (Unicode-aware), rename, delete

story: As a creator, I want an accessible player that shows lyrics and the AI label, so that everyone can use it
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard operable; ARIA; lyrics shown; label visible

story: As a creator, I want to share a private link or public page, so that others can hear my song
acceptance_criteria: Revocable share tokens; public page with moderation of title and lyrics

story: As a free user, I want to mark up to 5 songs a month for commercial use, so that I can use them in videos
acceptance_criteria: Quota enforced; certificate issued; attribution text provided

story: As a user, I want to download MP3 (and WAV when paid), so that I can use my song
acceptance_criteria: Signed URLs 15 min; formats by plan per entitlement matrix

story: As a user, I want failed or withheld takes refunded, so that I never pay for nothing
acceptance_criteria: Automatic refund with ledger entry

story: As the platform, I want prompts and lyrics moderated in Hindi, Hinglish and English, so that harmful content is blocked
acceptance_criteria: Red-team set passes; Unicode corpus passes; reasons shown

story: As the platform, I want generated audio screened for similarity, so that near-copies are withheld
acceptance_criteria: Screen runs on every take; withheld takes logged and refunded

story: As the platform, I want bot defence and caps, so that free generation is not abused
acceptance_criteria: Turnstile; daily caps; concurrency limits; velocity rules

story: As an admin, I want a console for users, caps and the moderation queue, so that I can run the beta
acceptance_criteria: Role-gated; MFA required; every action audited

story: As an admin, I want takedown and appeal workflows with deadline timers, so that we meet the 3-hour rule
acceptance_criteria: Orders path tested end to end; appeals queue works

story: As a user, I want to see prices in my currency for my country, so that the price is fair where I live
acceptance_criteria: Price bands applied by billing country

story: As an Indian user, I want to pay by UPI, card or net banking, so that I can subscribe
acceptance_criteria: Razorpay test and live mode; webhooks verified

story: As an international user, I want to pay through a merchant of record, so that taxes are handled
acceptance_criteria: Provider checkout; webhooks verified

story: As a paid user, I want ownership of songs I create, with a certificate, so that I can use them anywhere
acceptance_criteria: user_owned state; certificate; vesting on settlement; chargeback rule

story: As a user, I want to cancel online easily and keep my owned songs, so that I trust the service
acceptance_criteria: Three-step cancel; downloads still available

story: As a creator, I want to extend, trim, fade and regenerate a section, so that I can fix a take
acceptance_criteria: New version per edit; seam test passes

story: As a producer, I want four separated stems, so that I can mix my song
acceptance_criteria: Demucs stems; sum test; SDR reported

story: As the team, I want G1 listening tests run for Hindi, Hinglish and English, so that we know which languages launch
acceptance_criteria: 30 listeners per language; results against pass mark

story: As the founder, I want an investor demo script and recording, so that fundraising can start
acceptance_criteria: Five-minute demo of the beta flow on staging

story: As the team, I want a load test and a security baseline scan before beta, so that gate G2 is met
acceptance_criteria: k6 at 2x beta peak; ZAP baseline; findings triaged

story: As the team, I want accessibility checks in CI and a manual screen-reader pass, so that WCAG 2.2 AA holds
